newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Jan-May retail sales fall 53.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Jan-May retail sales fall 53.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Bulgarian retail sales in the first five months of this year were a real 53.8 percent lower than a year earlier due to soaring year-on-year inflation, National Statistics Institute (NSI) figures show.
BULGARIA RETAIL SALES JAN-MAY JAN-APRIL JAN-MAY'96
Consumer prices rose by 479.4 percent in the first five months and 1,840.2 percent year on year in May. Year on year inflation for May last year was 42.2 percent.
Sales of foods declined a real 46.9 percent year on year for the first five months, while sales of non-foods fell a real 56.4 percent.
Retail sales in May alone fell a real 47.0 percent year-on-year as food sales declined 42.4 percent and sales of non-foods shrank 49.8 percent year on year. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
